fact: Under the 20-year contract the IDEMIA/Afritech consortium produces the cards, manages the general population file and builds and operates the identification centres, per BBC News Afrique.
Trident's release says RDC-PASS is developed and operated by its subsidiary Trident DRC under a 20-year public-private partnership with the Government, with Trident as long-term operator.

ONIP's interim director general says ONIP is to manage the national data centre and the population file while the partner installs and maintains the system, and ONIP trainers are being trained by the partner, with agents trained in Paris 26 February to 1 March 2024.
